### Nev Flynn / nevflynn.com
There are **no** mentions of Nev Flynn, nevflynn.com, or anything described as inspired by that site. A search across `AGENTS*.md` for those names and for “inspired” / “influence” does not turn up anything relevant (only unrelated hits like “Never”, “reference”, “preferences”).

### Grid / layout style
Grid-related guidance is **centralized in [AGENTS-DESIGN.md](https://github.com/gonzalopozo/gonzalopozo.github.io/blob/main/AGENTS-DESIGN.md)**:

- **Intro**: “theme tokens, **bento grid** vocabulary, card anatomy, pill navbar, and interactive patterns.”
- **§1 Design philosophy**: “Cards first” — “The grid IS the layout.”
- **§3 Grid System**: `react-grid-layout` (Responsive), breakpoints (`lg` = 8 columns, etc.), gaps, shared vocabulary for card sizes (`tall`, `wide`, etc.), `min-h-0 min-w-0` for the layout engine.
- Elsewhere in the same file: grid card radius (`rounded-4xl`), shadows, responsive nav vs grid, checklists.

[AGENTS.md](https://github.com/gonzalopozo/gonzalopozo.github.io/blob/main/AGENTS.md) only **points** to `AGENTS-DESIGN.md` for “bento grid system” and design tokens; it does not name external portfolio inspirations.

**Summary:** Your AGENTS docs define a **bento / card-grid** system in `AGENTS-DESIGN.md` but do **not** document Nev Flynn or nevflynn.com as a reference. If that inspiration was intentional, it lives only in code or informal notes unless you add it to the docs yourself.
